description: This file defines the MiddlewareDispatcher class in the Slim Framework, handling middleware stack management, including adding middleware of various types (object, class name, callable), and executing middleware in a request lifecycle.

classes.name: MiddlewareDispatcher
classes.description: Class responsible for managing and executing a stack of middleware components in the Slim Framework. It supports adding middleware by instance, class name, or callable, and handles middleware resolution and invocation.

methods.name: seedMiddlewareStack
methods.description: Initializes the middleware stack with a given request handler.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Executes the middleware stack for a given server request, returning a response.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds middleware to the stack, accepting objects, class names, or callables.

methods.name: addMiddleware
methods.description: Adds a middleware object implementing MiddlewareInterface to the stack.

methods.name: addDeferred
methods.description: Adds middleware by class name, resolving it later during execution.

methods.name: addCallable
methods.description: Adds a callable middleware directly to the stack.
